name: Craftsman's Writ: White Bandit Mask
summary: A faded writ requests one White Bandit Mask and gives terms for its delivery and payment. It can be transferred, but you need it to complete the exchange.

sections.title: The Delivery
sections.body: The customer asks whether you have come with the delivery. The writ names a White Bandit Mask and gives a place for delivery and terms for payment. You need the writ with you to complete the exchange.

faq.answer: The customer requests one White Bandit Mask.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the mask?
faq.answer: The delivery location is marked on your map.

faq.q: Do I need to carry the writ?
faq.answer: Yes. You need the writ in your possession to complete the exchange.

faq.q: Can someone else carry the writ?
faq.answer: Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.

faq.q: What does the customer ask when I arrive?
faq.answer: The customer asks whether you are there for the delivery.
